==Overview==
These Imperial titles were established by [[386YE_Spring_Equinox_Senate_sessions#Create_titles_of_Voices_of_Virtue|a vote]] of the [[Senate]] during the Spring Equinox 386YE. There are seven voices in total - one for each of the Imperial Virtues.

==Responsibilities==
Each voice is responsible for acting as an inspiration to the pilgrims of the faith and laity as to what it means to be virtuous. 

==Appointment==
The seven Voices are appointed according to a schedule over the course of a year. They are [[Appointment|appointed]] by [[judgement]] of the appropriate Virtue Assembly. 

The title can be held by any citizen. The voice serves until the next scheduled election. They can be [[revocation|revoked]] by the [[Assembly#General_Assembly|General Assembly]], the appropriate [[Assembly#The_Virtue_Assemblies|Virtue Assembly]], and by the [[Assembly#Assembly_of_the_Nine|Assembly of the Nine]].

===Schedule===
The schedule for annual appointments is:
* Winter - [[Ambition]] and [[Vigilance]]
* Spring - [[Courage]] and [[Wisdom]]
* Summer - [[Loyalty]] and [[Pride]]
* Autumn - [[Prosperity]]
